correctness.rationale: The one-side condition is read as explicitly defined in the assumptions: the chosen matching covers all of S and has exactly one endpoint of each edge in S (without the coverage clause the shorthand in the Finding would be vacuous). An induced matching yields every trace by choosing a label-consistent endpoint per edge and extending the resulting independent set. For the converse, no isolated vertex belongs to a shattered support and its all-positive pattern makes S independent. For a leaf v and neighbor u, if v is queried, its negative label forces u into the independent set, and with the other labels all positive this proves they lie outside N[u]. If u is queried instead, fix its positive label and independence again keeps the other queries outside N[u]. In either case every witnessing maximal independent set containing u restricts to a maximal independent set of F−N[u], because no vertex there is adjacent to u and all other vertices of N[u] are excluded. Induct there and append uv; there are no extra adjacencies to either endpoint. If neither endpoint is queried, deleting v preserves the witnesses by dropping v and adding u only if it becomes undominated; conversely a maximal independent set after deletion extends by adding v exactly when u is absent. Isolates and the empty case then complete the induction. On C5, {0,2} realizes all four traces, and every four vertices induce a path, not two disjoint edges. The five-cycle has VC dimension exactly two (its maximal independent sets have size two). A fresh enumeration at /workspace/branches/2db30912-cf6b-47b3-b347-a06502761454/forest_mis_reproduction.py matched the frozen counts: 3,272 forests in orders 0–6, 197,635 support queries, 33,226 shattered supports, and exact equality of the two separately computed support families; it also reproduced the C5 obstruction. Output: forest_mis_reproduction_output.txt alongside the script. The frozen code and output were inspected, not rerun. The finite checks do not prove the unrestricted statement.

value.rationale: The converse supplies a structural certificate for every shattered support, not merely an extremal dimension, and its pendant reduction makes the criterion constructive.
